mapper.select: SELECT * FROM product_commission_config WHERE product_id = #{productId} AND status = 1 ORDER BY create_time DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT * FROM product_commission_config WHERE category_id = #{categoryId} AND product_id IS NULL AND status = 1 ORDER BY create_time DESC LIMIT 1
